subtopic_title: Rounding off numbers to the nearest 10, 100 and 1000
curriculum_objective_text: Round numbers to the nearest 10, 100, and 1000

record_links.rationale: This worked example rounds a number to the nearest ten.

heading_path.h3: Worked example 7.4: Rounding off to the nearest ten

record.evidence_quote: A smartphone is advertised for ₦47,689. Round off this number to the nearest ten.
record.prompt_text: A smartphone is advertised for ₦47,689. Round off this number to the nearest ten.
record.answer_text:
Step 1: Write down half of the required multiple of 10.

$$
\frac{1}{2}\times 10=5
$$

Step 2: Determine which digit represents the required multiple of 10.

You may use a place value table to help you with this:

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|}
\hline
\text{billion} & \text{hm} & \text{tm} & \text{million} &\text{hth} & \text{tth} & \text{thousand} & \text{ h } & \text{ t } & \text{ u }  \\
\hline
& & & & & 4 & 7 & 6 & 8 & 9     \\
\hline
\end{array}
$$

The 8 represents ten.

Step 3: Consider the digits to the right of the one you identified in Step 2. If they are less than the value in Step 1, the digit you identified remains the same. If they are equal to or more than the value in Step 1, the digit you identified increases by 1.

The digit to the right of the 8 is 9.
9&gt;5
The 8 increases to a 9.

Step 4: Write down the rounded number with the digit you determined in Step 3, and all the digits to the right become zero.

₦47,690

record_links.rationale: This note explains why the nearest-ten rounded answer is closer to 47,690 than 47,680.

record.evidence_quote: If we round off 47,689 to the nearest ten, we actually want to know whether this number is closer to 47,680 or 47,690. The number 47,689 is 1 unit away from 47,690 and 9 units away from 47,680. That is why it is rounded off to 47,690.
